assets.prompt: Create one polished editorial textbook illustration for an asynchronous professional-development course called Applying AI at Work. Use case: illustration-story. Intended asset: a modest wide landscape chapter illustration, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Style: sophisticated restrained 2D stock-style editorial illustration, lightly textured paper, crisp shapes, realistic adult proportions, navy ink outlines, muted slate blue, teal, warm cream background. Calm, professional, human. Scene: three adult colleagues around a modest worktable reviewing a paper workflow and passing a folder from one person to another; the folder and connecting handoff are the visual center. Include a laptop with simple abstract blocks and a few notes, no readable text anywhere. Diverse adult professionals, natural expressions, no exaggerated cartoon smiles. Open airy composition; generous white/cream breathing room; keep figures within the central band so the image reads well as a small wide illustration. Do not include titles, captions, logos, watermarks, gradients, sci-fi motifs, floating icons, or decorative UI. This is an illustrative scene, not documentary photography. Output only the finished image.
